title: ZECHARIAH 4:6
THE MIDDAY WATCH
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through a high study window
golden noon light on an empty wooden desk
sunlight streaming through sheer white curtains at noon
hazy midday light over a calm empty valley
bright noon sun casting soft shadows on a quiet room
warm midday light reflecting off a polished wooden surface
sunlight resting peacefully on an open book at noon
serene midday rays warming an empty sanctuary wall

scenes.a: If that looming obstacle feels far too large for your tired hands to move right now, listen closely.
We grow so exhausted trying to force open every locked door by our own sheer effort.
Lord, quiet our rushing minds during this busy middle hour of the day.
Remind us where true victory is found when human strength fails completely.
This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
Father, pour out your quiet spirit over our work, our homes, and our decisions right now.
Help us to trust your invisible grace instead of leaning on our own failing abilities.
Sustain us through the rest of this day with your enduring peace.
